item.title: Indianapolis bars brace for crowds of Hoosiers ahead of Monday’s IU game
item.description: Bars across Indianapolis are preparing for a busy Monday night as Hoosier fans plan to head out for IU watch parties, with many bars offering special deals and staffing up to accommodate the crowds.

item.title: Indiana football’s rise to No. 1 fueled by Mark Cuban’s financial support
item.description: Mark Cuban, a billionaire entrepreneur and Indiana alum, has donated millions to the Hoosiers football program, helping them rise from one of the most unsuccessful programs in college football history to the brink of a national title.

item.title: Braun makes championship wager with Florida governor
item.description: Indiana Gov. Mike Braun and Florida Gov. Ron DeSantis have made a friendly wager ahead of the College Football Playoff National Championship, with Braun offering pork and pie from Indiana, and DeSantis offering stone crabs and key lime pie from Florida.

item.title: 5 Indiana cities make U.S. News & World Report’s top 250 places to live
item.description: Five Indiana communities, including Carmel and Fishers, ranked among the top 250 best places to live in the U.S. in 2025-2026, according to U.S. News & World Report's latest ranking.

item.title: Why Fernando Mendoza’s high school coach knew the QB would be great
item.description: Indiana University junior quarterback Fernando Mendoza will have the chance to play for the national championship in his hometown of Miami on Monday night.

item.title: Curt Cignetti’s mentality for the national championship
item.description: The top-seeded IU football team is undefeated and preparing to play in their first national championship in program history, with head coach Curt Cignetti urging his team to remain sharp and focused ahead of the big game against Miami.

item.title: 2 dead, 2 injured, and a suspect in custody after Bloomington house fire
item.description: Four victims were found at a house fire on East Anderson Road early Sunday morning, and a suspect is in custody at Eskanazi hospital for injuries related to the fire.
